biotools.summary: Arborist is a method for inferring tumor phylogenies by integrating low-pass single-cell DNA sequencing (scDNA-seq) data with high-coverage bulk DNA sequencing data. It uses variational inference to improve the reconstruction of tumor evolutionary relationships.
